name: Mors
effect:
Restores 26–30% of Max HP to the selected character.
Regenerates 450–790 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
description: A fruit beverage in a deep red color, highly popular with young women in Snezhnaya for its pleasing sweet-and-sour taste. Wild-picked berries are slowly simmered over low heat, then crushed and strained. The resulting liquid is then mixed with honey and a little sugar before being left to cool and served.

suspicious.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.
suspicious.description: A fruit beverage in a deep red color. This murky, almost-purple drink is unbearably sour and bitter, as if it were made by pouring ink into suspicious water full of overnight fruit residue. It seems such a shame to pour it down the sink... but then again, drinking it doesn't seem any wiser.

delicious.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.
delicious.description: A fruit beverage in a deep red color. The sweet aroma of berry greets you before the glass ever reaches your lips. This perfectly balanced drink is bright and refreshing without ever feeling thin, with just enough honey to round out the berries' gentle tartness. One sip of this is all it takes to win over even the most discerning palate.
